mode.title: What to scan
mode.description: Scan both sources, only live Polymarket markets, or only Telegram Gifts collections.

limit.title: Max Polymarket markets
limit.description: Top markets by liquidity, then re-ranked by the 0-100 score.

minLiquidity.title: Minimum market liquidity (USD)
minLiquidity.description: Drops markets that are too thin to enter or exit.

minVolume24h.title: Minimum 24h volume (USD)
minVolume24h.description: 0 keeps markets with no trades in the last 24 hours.

minScore.title: Minimum score (0-100)
minScore.description: Only return candidates at or above this score. 70 = SNIPE, 50 = WATCH.

giftLimit.title: Max Telegram gift collections
giftLimit.description: When no explicit collections are given, the Actor takes the first N collections from fragment.com/gifts.

giftCollections.title: Gift collections to scan (optional)
giftCollections.description: Fragment collection slugs, for example ["plushpepe", "diamondring"]. Leave empty to auto-pick the top collections.

includeOffer.title: Include the Live Radar Pro offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one final record with the Pro dashboard link (TW1-RADAR), price and Plati.Market card.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request HTTP timeout for Polymarket and Fragment.
